assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of atherosclerotic heart disease and recent episodes of transient cerebral ischemic attacks, raising concern for an underlying paroxysmal arrhythmia such as atrial fibrillation.

To evaluate for intermittent cardiac rhythm disturbances that may be contributing to these ischemic events, a 30-day continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring study (CPT 93247) is medically necessary and appropriate for this patient.
This long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study supports the associated diagnosis codes G45.9 and I25.10.
